end.summary:
Named polygons by counting sides, including triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon and octagon.
Recognised polygons and triangles when rotated or shown in different positions.
Described triangles using equal sides and identified right and acute angle terms.
Teach-back was not passed; angle recognition needed further explanation.
end.parentNote: Veer practised naming polygons by their number of straight sides and recognising shapes even when they were tilted or rotated. They used side-counting and correctly identified triangles by equal sides; angle vocabulary was introduced, but recognising angles still needs practice. At home, ask them to find triangles and polygons around the house and count the sides, then spot any right, acute, or obtuse corners.
